name: @nori-zk/ethereum-snapshot
description: NoriSnapshot: make any Ethereum view call provable on Solana through the Nori proof request queue

scripts.build: ETH_NETWORK=hardhat npm run clean && ETH_NETWORK=hardhat hardhat compile && node stabilize-types.mjs . && tsc -p tsconfig.package.json
scripts.test: ETH_NETWORK=hardhat NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-wasm-modules hardhat test mocha test/NoriSnapshot.ts test/SnapshotReadVectors.ts test/DemoLockbox.ts; code=$?; node stabilize-types.mjs . && exit $code
scripts.test-ci: ETH_NETWORK=hardhat NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-wasm-modules hardhat test mocha test/NoriSnapshot.ts test/SnapshotReadVectors.ts test/DemoLockbox.ts; code=$?; node stabilize-types.mjs . && exit $code
scripts.test:fork: ETH_NETWORK=hardhat NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-wasm-modules hardhat test mocha test/fork/NoriSnapshot.mainnet.ts; code=$?; node stabilize-types.mjs . && exit $code
scripts.vectors:mainnet: VECTORS_NETWORK=mainnetFork ETH_NETWORK=hardhat NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-wasm-modules hardhat run scripts/generateSnapshotReadVectors.ts
scripts.lint: npx eslint *.ts tasks test vectors scripts
scripts.lint:fix: npx eslint *.ts tasks test vectors scripts --fix
